<p>The sun rose, and the exploration continued.</p><p>The pace was still slow, but they were steadily resolving everything without any casualties. Until last night, I’d been quietly frustrated that the exploration might drag on, but after witnessing *that* scene, my complaints melted away like snow.</p><p>‘This is it.’</p><p>Things I hadn’t noticed before were now coming into view.</p><p>Yesterday, I’d thought Oh Hana’s clingy behavior toward Jang Woo-seok was just the kind of thing close friends did. But now, I see it differently.</p><p>“Woo-seok, you’ve got blood here.”</p><p>Oh Hana is wiping the blood off Jang Woo-seok’s cheek with a tissue.</p><p>The distance between them is far too close for a simple act of cleaning, and the way her hand moves is subtly… suggestive.</p><p>‘Why is he making that face?’</p><p>Jang Woo-seok just laughs awkwardly, not knowing what to do with himself.</p><p>If I glance just a little behind them, I can see Kang Ye-rin watching the scene with a dark, cold expression.</p><p>Kim Ha-jun watches the three of them, lets out a deep sigh, and shakes his head.</p><p>‘Kim Ha-jun’s the most mature one here.’</p><p>Since last night, my sympathies have leaned slightly toward Kang Ye-rin.</p><p>I want to tell her right now, ‘This might be hard to believe, but that guy you like… he’s not some loyal bro. He’s just a dick-for-brains idiot. Pretend to go crazy and jump him—you’ll win.’</p><p>If Oh Hana gives off the vibe of a seductress who’s been around the block, Kang Ye-rin just seems like a girl who can’t even express her feelings properly in front of the guy she likes.</p><p>‘Show me the power of pure love.’</p><p>Every moment, scenes that put dramas to shame are unfolding live.</p><p>‘The exploration’s probably ending tomorrow… and this amazing show will be over by then…’</p><p>***</p><p>But the fun happened faster than I expected.</p><p>Due to Oh Hana’s mistake, a monster’s attack hit Jang Woo-seok directly.</p><p>He wasn’t seriously injured, and Jang Woo-seok brushed it off, saying he was fine, but Kang Ye-rin couldn’t hold back and shouted at Oh Hana, sparking a confrontation.</p><p>“What if you force an attack like that?! If you’re weak, then just… just stay in the back!”</p><p>“Ye-rin, I’m fine, so—”</p><p>“You be quiet…! It’s always because you try to cover for him that this kind of thing happens! This time, we got lucky and he didn’t get hurt, but if it had gone wrong, it could’ve been *really* dangerous!”</p><p>Oh Hana assessed the situation, bowed her head deeply, and said,</p><p>“S…sorry… I was just trying to do my best, I didn’t think it would turn out like this.”</p><p>‘Wow…’</p><p>Her acting is so good it’s impressive.</p><p>But Oh Hana didn’t stop there. When she lifted her head again, the crocodile tears streaming from her eyes were more than enough to flip the situation in her favor.</p><p>Kim Ha-jun stepped between them.</p><p>“C’mon, c’mon, everyone just stop… Since Wooseok hyung is fine, Hana noona, please be more careful next time, and Ye-rin noona, don’t react like that either…”</p><p>“W-what?!”</p><p>Kang Ye-rin flared up, but Oh Hana subtly grabbed Kim Ha-jun’s shoulder and spoke.</p><p>“Ha-jun… I *was* in the wrong, so… don’t say anything to Ye-rin…”</p><p>“Huh? Oh, no, I wasn’t saying anything like that…”</p><p>‘There it is. Queen Bee’s First Technique.’</p><p>Kang Ye-rin, exasperated, crossed her arms and let out a long, heavy sigh.</p><p>That’s when Jang Woo-seok approached Kang Ye-rin and said,</p><p>“Ye-rin… even if you have complaints during the exploration, our team rule is to not bring it up on the spot. We discuss it all together outside the Gate after the exploration ends, during the reflection meeting.”</p><p>Jang Woo-seok’s expression was firm.</p><p>Kang Ye-rin couldn’t bring herself to retort and just hemmed and hawed.</p><p>Internal conflict inside a Gate could escalate into a serious situation, so it was an unspoken rule to never voice complaints during an exploration, no matter the issue.</p><p>Jang Woo-seok’s point was perfectly reasonable—exactly what a leader should say.</p><p>‘If it weren’t for what happened yesterday…’</p><p>But ever since witnessing yesterday’s incident, no matter what Jang Woo-seok said, he just looked like a drone feeding royal jelly to the queen bee.</p><p>‘Huff—!’</p><p>In the brief moment I averted my gaze, I saw it—</p><p>Behind Jang Woo-seok and Kim Ha-jun, Oh Hana was smiling at Kang Ye-rin with a relaxed, smug expression.</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290704" loading="lazy">
</p><p>Kang Ye-rin’s hands began to tremble.</p><p>‘So this is how women’s power struggles work.’</p><p>For now, Oh Hana was winning by a landslide.</p><p>I couldn’t just stand by and watch, so I decided to step in.</p><p>“Everyone, stop it… Let’s keep moving with the exploration. The sun’s about to set, and we still need to find a place to rest for the night. Stop wasting time.”</p><p>I deliberately laced my voice with irritation. Everyone glanced at me, apologized, and wrapped up the situation before continuing the exploration.</p><p>***</p><p>Night fell, and we secured a shelter to spend the night before settling in.</p><p>For the first watch, we sent Kim Ha-jun and Oh Hana.</p><p>Left in the shelter were Jang Woo-seok, Kang Ye-rin, and me. The two of them hadn’t exchanged a single word since then.</p><p>More precisely, whenever Jang Woo-seok tried to talk to Kang Ye-rin, she either ignored him or walked away.</p><p>‘She’s really pissed.’</p><p>As someone who supports Kang Hye-na, it’s eating me up inside. I know that refusing to communicate is the absolute worst way to handle a relationship—it’s something you should never do.</p><p>Judging by her expression, Kang Hye-na looks like she’s going to quit the team after this expedition.</p><p>That’s why I came up with a new scenario. That’s why I intentionally sent Oh Hana and Kim Ha-jun to stand guard.</p><p>If I had sent Oh Hana and Jang Woo-seok together, Oh Hana would have definitely used her Queen Bee’s second technique, ‘Gaslighting.’ So I separated them.</p><p>When I suggested that Kim Ha-jun and I take the watch together, Oh Hana seemed to catch my intention—she stared at me with a rare look of flustered confusion.</p><p>In this awkward atmosphere, I was the first to speak up.</p><p>“Then… should we talk about what happened earlier?”</p><p>Jang Woo-seok looked a little surprised before answering.</p><p>“Supervisor… I’m truly sorry, but our team rule is to discuss complaints outside the Gate…”</p><p>“I know. My old teams did the same.”</p><p>“Then why…”</p><p>“Discussing things outside applies to minor complaints. But life-threatening moments like earlier are an exception. You got lucky and didn’t get hurt, so you’re acting like it was no big deal. But as Hye-na said, if that had hit a vital spot, or if the monster had been just a little stronger, it could’ve been deadly.”</p><p>Kang Hye-na looked at me with sparkling eyes.</p><p>It was the expression of someone who, surrounded by people blaming her, had finally found a savior telling her she’d made the right choice.</p><p>“But in the end, no one got hurt.”</p><p>“Ha!”</p><p>When Jang Woo-seok refused to back down, Kang Hye-na let out a scoff.</p><p>‘I need to push harder.’</p><p>“Yes, well… we were lucky. May I offer some advice from my experience?”</p><p>“Go ahead.”</p><p>“I’m sorry to say this, but people like you, Woo-seok, tend to die the fastest after becoming official Hunters.”</p><p>“…”</p><p>The atmosphere inside the shelter turned icy.</p><p>“If you die, that’s on you. But Oh Hana’s actions put not just herself but the entire team in danger. People who brush off things like that as ‘no big deal’ don’t last long. Actually, everyone I’ve known like that is either dead now, missing a limb, or survived by sacrificing their teammates and got buried alive by the Hunter community.”</p><p>“Ah…”</p><p>Jang Woo-seok looked genuinely shocked by my harsh words.</p><p>“Of course, as the leader, how you handled the situation was your call. But what I’m saying is that acting like it was nothing is the problem.”</p><p>“Yes, thank you.”</p><p>Fortunately, my words seemed to get through—Jang Woo-seok’s expression turned serious.</p><p>‘Kang Ye-rin… I think I’ve done all I can at this point.’</p><p>I passed the ball to Kang Ye-rin, who was standing in front of the goal. Now everything was up to her.</p><p>Jang Woo-seok buried his face in his hands, sighed a few times, then lifted his head and stood up. He walked over to Kang Ye-rin, took her hand, and spoke.</p><p>“Uh-uh?”</p><p>Kang Ye-rin’s face turned red as she let out a strange noise.</p><p>“Ye-rin… I’m sorry. In that situation, I should’ve been the one to say it clearly, but I always end up pushing that role onto you. Maybe I’m not qualified to be a leader.”</p><p>Kang Ye-rin frantically waved her hands and said,</p><p>“No, no! I was the one who got too emotional back there… I should’ve told you separately…”</p><p>“No, after all the time we’ve spent together, I was the one who—”</p><p>“I said it’s not! I was the one who acted out first!”</p><p>Watching this heartwarming scene, I mentally shed tears and gave a standing ovation.</p><p>“Then… I’ll head out for my shift a little early.”</p><p>With those words, I left the two of them alone in the shelter and exited.</p><p>As I walked away, I glanced back and saw the two of them chatting brightly, standing close together.</p><p>‘Ah, this is it.’</p><p>I was proud of myself.</p><p>I was also proud of Kang Ye-rin for not dropping the pass I’d given her.</p><p>I was grinning to myself, but by the time I reached the lookout point, my smile had vanished.</p><p>“Ah, fuck me.”</p><p>The two of them were gone.</p><p>My brain sent a danger signal, as if sensing the worst-case scenario.</p><p>I sharpened my senses and scoured the area like a fine-toothed comb until I found where the noise was coming from.</p><p>‘Over there…’</p><p>I muffled my footsteps, hid in the grass, and focused on the source of the sound.</p><p>“This is insane, seriously.”</p><p>There was Oh Ha-na, stroking Kim Ha-jun’s cock.</p><p>“Noona, it’s dirty there… ah…”</p><p>“That’s why Noona’s cleaning it for you.”</p><p>“We shouldn’t do this… teammates shouldn’t…!”</p><p>“Why not?”</p><p>‘I’ve been outplayed…’</p><p>Oh Ha-na was definitely a step ahead of me.</p><p>As soon as I isolated Jang Woo-seok and myself, she must’ve set her sights on Kim Ha-jun.</p><p>Fortunately, from the looks of it, Kim Ha-jun hadn’t had any sexual contact with Oh Ha-na yet.</p><p>‘Ha-jun! Reject her! You can do it!’</p><p>I started cheering for Kim Ha-jun in my head.</p>
